metadata.generator: one offline OD planning pass, never used as the measured experiment
metadata.name: abb_interp_unique_50
metadata.physical_prefix_rule: unique logical request ID; original native RingHash; no ID search
metadata.tail_C_rule: nearest integer miss on fixed-hit data bilinear C grid to (E_k-s_i,k)/8; replay stored_us/1000

input.reference_rate_definition: sum over NPUs of own total bytes on disk / own total pure compute seconds; NOT time-average active-profile demand or arrival rate

finite_input_capacity_bound.caveat: Necessary workload-only lower bound, not an attainable scheduler optimum and not a bound on a selected warm window.

frozen_input_arithmetic.caveat: Calculated after offline planning from the frozen input. This is a conditional arithmetic identity, not an independent pre-planning prediction or a measured replay result.

same_population_slo_1p5.definition: same entire finite request population; admission to prefill completion <= 1.5*own 8C + 1e-9ms; excludes admission queue

layer_cycle_supply.method: At each compute start, the only new read is next layer or next request L0; all of that read reaches NPU before next compute start. Therefore exact SSD bytes in this full per-NPU cycle = next-layer manifest V. Initial cold reads and final compute without prefetch are excluded.
layer_cycle_supply.caveat: Asynchronous cycle averages are not instantaneous SSD rates; their sum may exceed physical disk capacity. Display clipping must retain full-cycle denominator. No exact physical service integral at arbitrary 20s window boundaries is claimed.

depth_control.interpretation: For this exact input, changing only OD queue depth to unlimited changes no request/layer timing. Enqueue-based latency diagnostics change because waiting moves to the host; this is not a speedup. Does not generalize to other inputs.

seed_control.interpretation: Only equal-timestamp client submission order changes. In this run it caused no effective OD timing perturbation; it is not compute/service noise robustness or a second random workload sample.

independent_method: raw JSON input model, RingHash, full layer durations, compute/stall integrals, exact admitted-profile demand events; no simulator/runner imported
